page: Microsoft Azure L96aos_v5 is a dedicated virtual machine instance belonging to the Laosv5 server family. It is powered by an AMD processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 96 dedicated vCPUs and 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. It does not include any GPU hardware.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive local storage capacity, providing 69115 GB of local storage. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for high-throughput and low-latency disk operations. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the L96aos_v5 offers high resource density, combining substantial memory capacity with an exceptionally large local storage allocation. This hardware profile is designed for data-intensive workloads. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, big data analytics, enterprise storage systems, and memory-intensive transactional applications that require massive local disk space.
